title: The Borrowed Inheritance
author: Beatrix Sterling
blurb: Mirabel Coldharbour, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the witness everyone swears is dead, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
